Title: Micro Ingredients Multi Collagen Complex, 240 Capsules
Body (HTML):
Micro Ingredients offers a multi collagen peptides complex with each bottle providing extra strength capsules and a full-spectrum collagen blend with five essential types. 

Packaging & Dosage Options 

240 Capsules – 80 Servings 

3 Capsules Daily – 1,100mg Multi Collagen Complex, 2,500mcg Biotin, 72mg Vitamin C, and 55mg Hyaluronic Acid Per Serving  

How it Works 

5 Collagen Types in Every Serving: Features collagen types I, II, III, V, and X sourced from natural bovine, chicken bone broth, fish, and eggshell membrane to create a complete multi-source collagen formula. 

Comprehensive Extra Strength Formula: Includes biotin, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin C, providing a diverse formula for optimal absorption, utilization, and strength of collagen. 

Clean & Trusted 

Manufactured in cGMP compliant facility 

Non-GMO and free of wheat, soy, dairy, gluten, & tree nuts 

3rd party lab tested for purity, safety, and potency
